1939 Register, schedule 167, 9 Lenton Avenue, ED letter code RMGB, Nottingham registration district 430-3, sub-district 26, The National Archives RG101/6178A - read from the page by A. Hagues; sub number 3; **A. Hagues has not said which way the bracket runs on this schedule.** The index writes her Pointon (Brown); the page image has POINTON written above the line in a later hand, which makes Brown the name on the night. Entered as Brown with Pointon kept as the married name, and open to correction
